scope: Private S31 bootloader hardware initialization: internal analog-I2C byte transactions, PSRAM XTAL clock/reset gates and narrow MPLL shutdown; no board/app/display readiness.
sources: sources.json: fixed ESP-IDF v6.1 fff9895c82d744c7237be8847347bdd1b07c6643 bootloader_esp32s31.c, regi2c_impl.c, modem register headers, regi2c_bias.h, hp_sys_clkrst_reg.h, pmu_reg.h and hp_alive_sys_reg.h.

semantics.modemClock: 0x20587040 bit0 RW reset1; gates all modeled analog controller MMIO; no RF/modem operation.
semantics.analogTarget: BIAS slave0x6a, registers0/1 only; values must be explicit host input, no public silicon reset values available.
semantics.transactions: Two digital masters use active-low slave enable and CONF2 route. Every completed read/write changes actual target/controller data. BUSY is idle only after the synchronous operation; timing not modeled.
semantics.reset: Digital master reset clears controller registers while preserving analog target bytes. Functional reset-domain assumption; no independent silicon measurement.
semantics.psram: 0x20587068 defaults0x181. SYS/core clocks and AXI/APB resets gate actual external mapped reads/writes/fetches, not fake readiness; explicit backing memory remains required. PLL mux and FORCE_NORST unsupported.
semantics.mpll: Only documented bootloader WT shutdown commands, corresponding ALIVE gate and ACTIVE profile fields. No PLL power-up/lock, voltage or oscillator output.
semantics.sourceClock: MODEM_SYSCON CLK_CONF reset0x200002 includes unrelated PWDET divider1 at bit1; digital source selection retained, no 160MHz PLL waveform or settling implied.

positive.uart: S31 ANALOG ROUTE RESET MPLL PASS

validation.productionParity: Production source paths are unchanged by this stage; S31 is absent from CLI/WASM dependencies. Production WASM remains byte-identical to3344ed58. New-worktree native binary/text hashes differ from previous builds, so no native byte-identity claim: fixed artifacts were actually timed and guest outputs/counts compared.

reproduce.officialProbe: cargo build --release -p esp32s31 --example bringup; python3 tools/s31-native-firmware-probe.py --firmware-url <caller-URL> --sha256 <caller-SHA256> --rom <public20260528-S31-ROM-ELF> --rom-spi0-shadow --nor-jedec ef4018 --analog-bias 0000 --steps 2000000 --output <receipt.json>
reproduce.defaults: Omit --analog-bias to retain strict missing-input rejection. Omit --rom-spi0-shadow to retain strict documented SPI0 register map.

privacy: Only public source URLs, firmware/ROM hashes, bounded guest output, test assertions and aggregate benchmark data retained. Official firmware bytes are never written to disk by the probe. Raw local build paths remain only in ignored logs; committed receipts retain log hashes, not host paths.
